title: Investigating the Impact of Quantization Methods on the Safety and Reliability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended generated responses for unfair, discriminatory, and stereotyping content using human annotators and an LLM-as-a-judge (via the XSAFETY and OpenSafetyMini datasets), as well as measuring multiple-choice accuracy on the 'Unfairness and Bias' category of the SafetyBench benchmark.
